claims.claim: Suitable for Toyota Corolla, Carry, Hilux
claims.evidence: No brand, model, VIN, or fitment markings visible in Photos 0-2.
Photos cannot show country of origin or import status.
No video or photo shows the engine turning over or running.
No compression test or internal inspection is shown.
No odometer reading or mileage record is visible.
No teardown history or seal condition is shown.

risks.risk: Engine does not run or turn over
risks.proof: Video of the engine cranking and running

risks.risk: Internal damage or wear, including knock
risks.proof: Compression test results or borescope video of internals
risks.if_unproven: priced as having unknown or damaged internals

risks.proof: Service history or verifiable odometer reading
risks.if_unproven: priced as high mileage and unknown age

risks.risk: ECU, wiring harness, or ancillaries missing
risks.proof: Photo showing all included components and connectors
risks.if_unproven: priced as engine and gearbox only, without ancillaries

risks.risk: Incorrect fitment for the buyer's vehicle
risks.proof: VIN/chassis number or confirmed Toyota fitment listing
Clear photo of bell housing showing torque converter or clutch assembly
risks.if_unproven: priced as manual only because clutch pressure plates are visible

proof_requests: Video of the engine turning over and running
Compression test results for all cylinders
Photo of any visible chassis, engine, or gearbox identification numbers
Photo showing whether ECU, wiring harness, and ancillaries are included
response.reason: The witness identified the item as a used engine and gearbox assembly, so it can be priced at its worst case; all seller claims about condition, origin, and fitment are unproven and are listed as risks.
